ads.headline: Maya stopped chasing intake emails
ads.message: See how an independent consultant moved every client request into one clear intake flow and stopped copying answers between inboxes. Start with the same workflow in Formflow.
ads.visual: A natural screen recording moves a real-looking request from New to Ready while a small portrait of Maya remains in the corner and narrates what changed.

ads.headline: Every client request, ready when you are
ads.message: Collect the brief, files, and missing answers before work begins. Formflow keeps the request and every follow-up in one status board.
ads.visual: A split screen changes from a crowded email inbox to a clean board with New, Waiting, Ready, and Complete columns.

ads.headline: One link replaces five intake follow-ups
ads.message: Send one branded intake link. Conditional questions gather the right details and automatic reminders ask for anything the client missed.
ads.visual: Five follow-up email cards collapse into one branded Formflow link, followed by a completed structured client record on screen.
